warnings.message: Composer: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for Composer 2.11.1, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Use Composer 2.11.1 or a recent version wherever the project is installed; Composer has no setting that pins its version in the project

warnings.message: Composer has no setting for VCS repository dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Composer has no setting for package repository dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Composer: composer.lock records a hash of config.policy in composer.json, which this change alters, so composer.lock is out of date: composer install warns about it and composer validate fails
warnings.fix: Run composer update --lock, which writes the new hash without updating packages, and commit composer.lock
